n_valid.desc: valid starts (RT 0.100-0.300 s, not FS, not DNS)

n_athletes_identified.desc: distinct identified athletes among valid starts

fs_per_1000_starts.desc: recorded false starts per 1,000 starts (RT<0.100 or TR16.8; Wilson CI)

n_dq_non_fs_valid_rt.desc: DQs for non-start reasons whose legal RT is kept

median_rt_ms_M.desc: median valid RT, sex=M (race-cluster bootstrap CI)

median_rt_ms_W.desc: median valid RT, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap CI)

median_rt_ms_timing_Omega.desc: median valid RT, timing system Omega (unadjusted)

median_rt_ms_timing_Seiko.desc: median valid RT, timing system Seiko (unadjusted)

sex_diff_W_minus_M_ms.desc: women minus men, adjusted for round, event type, championship/race/athlete effects

event_200m_minus_flat_ms.desc: 200m minus flat sprints (100 m, indoor 60 m), adjusted

event_hurdles_minus_flat_ms.desc: hurdles minus flat sprints (100 m, indoor 60 m), adjusted

icc_race_within_compyear.desc: race variance / (race + athlete + residual): within-championship race ICC

sd_rt_within_compyear.desc: SD of RT within championship after sex/round/event (race+athlete+residual)

lrt_meet_chi2.desc: LRT: championship fixed effects vs none (ML)

trend_ms_per_decade.desc: linear trend in RT per decade (championship random effect)

share_lt105_M.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.105) s, sex=M (race-cluster bootstrap)

share_lt105_W.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.105) s, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap)

share_lt110_M.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.110) s, sex=M (race-cluster bootstrap)

share_lt110_W.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.110) s, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap)

share_lt120_M.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.120) s, sex=M (race-cluster bootstrap)

share_lt120_W.desc: share of valid RTs in [0.100-0.120) s, sex=W (race-cluster bootstrap)

tail_mass_pooled_exgauss_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, exgauss, sex=M (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_pooled_slognorm_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, slognorm, sex=M (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_pooled_swald_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, swald, sex=M (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_pooled_exgauss_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, exgauss, sex=W (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_pooled_slognorm_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, slognorm, sex=W (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_pooled_swald_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) for a gun-triggered start, pooled over meets, swald, sex=W (left-truncated fit; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_meet_max_M.desc: highest per-meet fitted P(RT<0.100), ex-Gaussian, sex=M

tail_mass_meet_min_M.desc: lowest per-meet fitted P(RT<0.100), ex-Gaussian, sex=M

tail_mass_meet_max_W.desc: highest per-meet fitted P(RT<0.100), ex-Gaussian, sex=W

tail_mass_meet_min_W.desc: lowest per-meet fitted P(RT<0.100), ex-Gaussian, sex=W

tail_mass_ref_exgauss_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, exgauss, sex=M (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_ref_slognorm_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, slognorm, sex=M (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_ref_swald_M.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, swald, sex=M (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_ref_exgauss_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, exgauss, sex=W (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_ref_slognorm_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, slognorm, sex=W (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

tail_mass_ref_swald_W.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100), average championship / first round / flat sprint, swald, sex=W (per-observation truncation; race-cluster bootstrap CI) - an extrapolation

fast_group_halfB_mean_diff_ms.desc: held-out (half-B) mean RT of the fastest-quartile athletes minus all eligible athletes (selection on half A, so no regression-to-the-mean bias)

tail_mass_fast_group.desc: fitted P(RT<0.100) per start for fastest-quartile athletes (held-out starts, ex-Gaussian, reference level men/first round/flat sprint/average championship; athlete-cluster bootstrap) - an extrapolation

fs_recorded_with_rt.desc: recorded false starts with an RT value

fs_near_threshold_090_100.desc: recorded false starts with RT in [0.090, 0.100) s

fast_group.reference_level: men, first round, flat sprint (100 m / indoor 60 m), average championship

M.note: ex-Gaussian fitted to conditional residuals (BLUP shrinkage leaves some between-athlete variance in them, so within-athlete spread is if anything overstated)

W.note: ex-Gaussian fitted to conditional residuals (BLUP shrinkage leaves some between-athlete variance in them, so within-athlete spread is if anything overstated)
